Test Description: Exercise PCIe configuration space access after link training: program DBI DSP Coherency Control 3 registers on both controllers, poll SII status until link-ready, configure RC memory base, probe and program BAR registers, enable Command register (Memory/IO/Bus Master), and wait for a completion handshake via a status register.
Meta Test Description: The test starts by clearing a handshake/status register at 0xE6004100. It conditionally performs link training for the selected topology (DM0_RC/DM1_RC/DM0_EP/DM1_EP) and programs cache/coherency by updating DBI_DSP_COHERENCY_CONTROL_3_OFF fields on both controller instances: set bits [11:14], [3:6], [27:30], and [19:22] to 0xF using set_data() and write_reg(). It then waits briefly and rewrites those fields to ensure settings are latched. Next, it polls the SII status register at offset 0xC0: read_sii0_reg(0xC0) and (when DM1_RC) read_sii1_reg(0xC0) until (value & 0xD1) == 0xD1, indicating link/ready status. It calls non_secure_prot_nic() and sets 0xE6004100 to 0x11111111, then delays. For DM0_RC, it runs mem_base_program_dm0_x4(), reads the first 10 DWORDs of PCIe config space (read_pcie_slv0_reg(i*4) for i=0..9), performs BAR sizing writes (write 0xFFFFFFFF to offsets 0x10..0x24), reads back those BAR offsets (0x10..0x24), then programs BAR values with 0x0, 0x4, 0x20000000, 0x40000000, 0x60000000, 0x80000000 at offsets 0x10..0x24 and reads them back again. It finally enables Memory/IO/Bus Master by writing 0x7 to the Command register at offset 0x04. For DM1_RC, analogous steps use the instance-1 accessors (mem_base_program_dm1_x4, read_pcie_slv1_reg/write_pcie_slv1_reg). After a short wait, the test repeatedly reads 0xE6004100 until it equals 0x12345678, then calls finish(0).
Remarks: Ensure PCIe link training completes and SII status indicates ready before configuration accesses. Coherency settings must be applied on both controllers via the Coherency Control 3 registers. BAR probing (0xFFFFFFFF writes) should be performed before assigning BAR values. Enable Command register only after BAR configuration. The test expects a system-level handshake where the status register transitions to 0x12345678.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Initialize PCIe: perform link training for the selected configuration and apply coherency settings on both controllers. 2) Poll SII status until link/ready bits are asserted. 3) Configure the RC memory base for the active controller. 4) Read initial PCIe configuration space header DWORDs to confirm access. 5) Probe BARs by writing all 1s to each BAR offset and read back to determine size masks. 6) Program BAR registers with target addresses and read back to confirm programming. 7) Enable Memory, IO, and Bus Master in the Command register. 8) Wait for the system handshake: poll the status register until it matches the expected completion value. 9) Declare the test PASS upon successful handshake.
